objective: Run the first bounded formal information-ladder diagnostic using hop and info_queue deterministic routing anchors under the fixed 200 Mbps M-Lab multi-OD burst at trace seeds 7 and 11; defer info_physical to a separately reviewed follow-up matrix.
context: R03 established a reproducible two-seed pressure contract and exposed descriptive congestion patterns.
The two arms differ only in routing.policy; all topology, demand, link model, control-plane and execution settings are held fixed.
This first F0 comparison diagnoses local queue information, not learner observation tensors; it cannot establish algorithm superiority or Q0 optimality.
excluded_inputs: Any post-review load, topology, seed, endpoint or policy change
Any future geometry, remote queue or oracle state not declared by the arm policy
Any claim of learner information value, superiority, Q0 optimality or paper-ready significance
deliverables: A compiled and independently reviewed four-cell matrix with exact policy-only intervention paths
Four serial natural-end VM receipts on the exact deployed main SHA
A persisted V2 analysis with one paired descriptive delivery/backlog/utilization/latency contrast and independent verification
An evidence note stating whether the information-ladder anchors are suitable for the next learner/Q0 stage
acceptance: All four cells use phase=non_learning, identical fixed 200 Mbps M-Lab multi-OD burst settings and paired trace seeds 7/11.
Every receipt verifies natural_end, conservation_ok, research_eligible and the required physical/packet ledgers.
The V2 analysis recomputes the single declared info_queue-minus-hop contrast from raw receipts; persisted verification returns ok=true with no errors.
If any cell fails, the matrix is not complete until the failure is diagnosed and the affected cell is rerun under the same authorization.
cannot_claim: This four-cell F0 diagnostic does not establish algorithm superiority, causal information value, learner observation equivalence, Q0 optimality, a final E0 threshold or paper-ready statistical significance.
A failed, non-natural-end, non-conservative or unauthorized run cannot be counted as an experiment result.
